## What changes

Describe the user outcome and the smallest implementation surface.

## Authority and data boundary

- New files, network destinations, tools, processes, secrets, or permissions: none / describe
- Preview, approval, cancellation, recovery, and redaction behavior: none / describe
- Public fixtures are synthetic: yes / not applicable

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated tests for behavior and failure paths
- [ ] Ran the relevant Rust, Python, Dashboard, and desktop checks
- [ ] Updated English and Chinese user-facing copy together
- [ ] Kept private Vaults, credentials, logs, runtime state, and generated personal artifacts out of Git
- [ ] Documented any intentionally incomplete platform or release gate

## Screenshots or artifacts

Use synthetic data only. Include before/after evidence when the UI or output format changes.
